title: Il mio racconto: mi presento
summary: Week 1 capstone: sounds, greetings, essere & avere — then build your first real self-introduction

blocks.title: Uno sguardo indietro: settimana 1
blocks.body: In one week you've met the **pure vowels** and the **c/g** rules, the **gn/gli/sc** sounds and **double consonants**, how to **greet** by register, the bar, and two verbs that run everything: **essere** (sono/sei/è…) and **avere** (ho/hai/ha…), plus **non** for no and **c'è / ci sono** for pointing things out. Bel lavoro — un caffè te lo sei meritato.
blocks.callout: This is the end of Week 1. Everything from here builds on essere + avere.

lines.nl: Sono di Toronto e sto imparando l'italiano.
lines.en: I'm from Toronto and I'm learning Italian.

blocks.prompt: Which sentence is correct for 'I'm hungry'?
blocks.explain: *Ho fame* — Italian *has* hunger. A week-1 keeper.

blocks.prompt: You greet a shop owner you don't know, at 9am. Best choice?
blocks.explain: *Buongiorno* — polite and time-appropriate. Save *ciao* for friends.

blocks.prompt: Say 'I'm from Rome' — and try dropping the pronoun.
blocks.hint: essere for 'I' is *sono*; the pronoun is optional.
blocks.explain: *Sono di Roma.* The -o ending already means 'I', so *io* is usually dropped.

blocks.prompt: Listen and type the whole line.
blocks.speak: Mi chiamo Sara e sono italiana.
answers: mi chiamo sara e sono italiana
mi chiamo sara e sono italiana.

pairs.note: Same greeting job, different register. When in doubt, buongiorno.

blocks.scene: Giulia introduces you to Pietro, visiting from Naples — a first hello

lines.speaker: Giulia
lines.nl: Lui è Pietro, un amico di Napoli.
lines.en: This is Pietro, a friend from Naples.

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: Piacere, Pietro. Mi chiamo Alex, sono canadese.
lines.en: Nice to meet you, Pietro. My name's Alex, I'm Canadian.
lines.spotlight: Your first full self-intro in the wild: name + where you're from.

lines.speaker: Pietro
lines.nl: E sei qui a Bologna per studiare?
lines.en: And are you here in Bologna to study?

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: Sono qui da poco e sto imparando l'italiano.
lines.en: I've been here a little while and I'm learning Italian.

blocks.title: Il mio racconto — livello 1

slots.label: Cosa fai

blocks.sample: Ciao, mi chiamo Alex, e sono di Toronto, e sto imparando l'italiano.

blocks.prompt: Il mio racconto — livello 1! Write your own short self-introduction: your name, where you're from, and that you're learning Italian. Use essere and, if you like, avere. This intro grows every week — keep it somewhere. Complimenti per la prima settimana!
